supersededBy.reason: Subjects changed after the #336 re-review; see the successor. Nothing below was edited.

supersedes.reason: The #336 review (CHANGES) rewrote dossier rule 4, the guidance, the illustration and the discovery-reduce prompt and added quotations.ts and dossier-validation.ts; every subject except provider-draft.ts and discovery-provider.ts changed, so the whole population was re-run at one commit with the committed runner.

method: Before every mutant the runner rewrites every subject from its committed bytes, checks each subject's sha256 against the commit, and runs the unmutated battery (`npx vitest run` over the five test files), which must pass with no failure. It then replaces exactly one occurrence of `old` with `new` in `file` (applied only when `old` occurs exactly once), runs the battery, and restores and re-checks every subject. Killed means the run exited non-zero with at least one failed test.

firstRun.finding: q-first-close-only survived: quotationsMatch tried every closing double quote, so any quotation whose opening up to an inner quote matched a source passed with an unverified tail. 71b0ec3a ends a quotation at the last double quote before the next lead and adds two refusal tests; this record is the full re-run at that commit.
